content.comment_body: Can anyone explain how to get the latest update? I tried downloading from the site, but it says I need to wait for a registration check. I bought [product_name] [version_no], and I have 5 pieces of the newer hardware ([article_no]) to install this week, but I’m unsure how to proceed.

There isn’t another way. The download is subject to export controls, and approval depends on the info you provided during registration. You’ll need to wait for an email confirming you’ve been approved for the download from [company_name].

They should at least have the new software version for sale. I bought [product_name] [version_no], which worked fine for two years. But now the updated hardware ([article_no], 12/24 revision) won’t communicate unless using the newer program. Connecting with older hardware ([article_no]) works as before. The seller who supplied the new devices said I need [product_name] [version_no] to connect to these. How can I get it? I need to program and install five units this week.

I’m sorry, but we understand your frustration. However, this forum is made up of users like yourself trying to help each other. We’re not employed by [company_name] and don’t have any influence over them. [company_name] only provides the platform and moderation.

Your only option right now is to use [product_name] [version_no] and save your project as a binary dump file onto an SD card via your computer. Then insert the SD card into the device and start it up. This works, but you can’t connect for online monitoring without [product_name] [version_no].

Thank you for the suggestions; I appreciate it. It’s unfortunate that [company_name] released a product without considering these issues. While using an SD card helps, it’s complicated for parameter changes. As a simpler solution, I might go buy five alternative devices from another brand. Thanks again.
Your seller might have had a starter kit with the [product_name] [version_no] DVD included. I’m not sure if [company_name] sells the DVD separately or not.

He didn’t say he has starter kits. Also, [company_name] does sell the software separately, but you can’t be sure it’s actually [product_name] [version_no], since they use the same [article_no] as prior versions like [version_no].
I searched in [company_name] online store and couldn’t find a [version_no] starter kit; only [version_no] was listed. Maybe it’s just not available for sale yet.
Sharing links that bypass export controls isn’t permitted and is not lawful. Please remove any such links, since posting them breaks both legal requirements and forum rules.

Ok, I’ve deleted the link. Just to clarify: it was an official update from [company_name], not a cracked or illegal version, and the user had legally purchased [product_name] [version_no]. The update to [version_no] is official and free. What is illegal about that?

It should be obvious that [company_name] doesn’t request personal details for download approval just for fun. There are export controls. If you circumvent this, it’s a violation of their terms, as [company_name] owns the copyright. Even if it’s annoying and takes time, you don’t have the right to distribute the software freely. If you aren’t sure, contact a moderator. Here’s some info for you: reasons for login and registration when downloading export-restricted software, and required data.

I understand your points, but I don’t appreciate being portrayed as distributing illegal software. I was just trying to help. The user only needs support staff to approve the registration, which doesn’t involve special conditions or payment. The user bought [company_name] hardware and simply couldn’t start the project due to how the update is made available. I shared only a mirror of the official link: [url]. Ok, next time I’ll stay out of it.
You still don’t seem to understand. What you did is not legal. The software’s copyright belongs to [company_name], and they decide who is allowed to download it and when.

Hello [user_name], Thank you for trying to help. It’s good that members are willing to assist. I have to agree with [user_name]; anyone needing software under export regulations (national, European, US) must wait for the verification. Alternatives: • Complete registration to activate the verification, then the download will be available. • Contact your local [company_name] representative for assistance. The restriction does not depend on whether you purchased the software or not; the update contains parts that can’t be delivered everywhere. For more info, check Wikipedia about Export Administration Regulations. Best regards [user_name]

Hi, In my experience, once you pass the export regulation check and get approval for downloading export-controlled software, you won’t have to do it again. If it times out, it is automatically checked in the background. A colleague who works with [product_name] and [product_name] for years says this never affects customers for those products—they understand the regulations. By the way, [product_name] [version_no] has been available on DVD since November 2020. If you order, you'll get [version_no] (but the DVD is not free). The order number can be found in the device manual. Hope this helps!

The [article_no] is the same for [version_no] as for previous versions. There’s no guarantee you’ll get [version_no], since both [company_name] and dealers may want to sell existing stock of older versions first before updating inventory. You are reminded that upgrading from an older version to [version_no] is available free of charge.

I was asked for verification before downloading the software twice—once for [product_name] [version_no], then again for [version_no]. I also needed confirmation for a third time when ordering from the [company_name] online shop. Each time, there’s a validation process before permission is granted.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are facing delays and frustration because their existing software does not support new hardware revisions. Only the latest version of the software is compatible, and access to it is controlled by export restrictions, lengthy registration, and unclear information about availability. These issues disrupt user workflow and prevent timely project delivery.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect immediate access to software compatible with new hardware, whether through purchase or download, to complete programming and installation tasks efficiently and without unnecessary delays.
